settings.heading: Complaints Procedure
settings.body_text: If something's not right, we want to know. Here's exactly how to raise a concern, what happens next, and how quickly we'll respond.

settings.heading: Get In Touch — Any Way That Suits You
settings.body: Email us at sales@furnitureinstore.co.uk, call 02476 581 053, or message us on WhatsApp. Please include your full name, contact details, order number, a clear description of the issue, any supporting photos or videos, and a timeline of events.

settings.title: Acknowledgement
settings.text: We'll confirm receipt of your complaint within 3 working days.

settings.title: Investigation
settings.text: Our team reviews the complaint thoroughly and may request further information.

settings.title: Resolution
settings.text: We aim to provide a full response and resolution within 14 working days — replacement, repair, refund or an alternative.

settings.title: Follow-Up
settings.text: We'll keep you informed throughout and make sure you're satisfied with the outcome.

settings.heading: Our Four-Step Resolution Process
settings.body: A clear, transparent path from first contact to full resolution.

settings.title: Your Rights
settings.text: Making a complaint never affects your legal rights under consumer law. You may withdraw a complaint at any time.

settings.title: Fair & Monitored
settings.text: Every complaint is recorded and monitored — helping us continuously improve our service.

settings.title: What We Accept
settings.text: Delivery issues, product defects and service concerns are all welcome so we can put things right.

settings.heading: What You Can Expect From Us
Ready to raise a concern?
settings.body: Our team is standing by. Drop us a line — we'll take it from there.
